name: Aoide Sidecar
description: Sync service for the Aoide curation store: playlists, folders, likes, play history and queue state.
overview: Relays the Aoide curation-store op log between a user's devices.

versions.changelog: Bound payload nesting depth so one over-nested row cannot wedge inbound sync, and refuse it per-op instead of failing the whole batch.
First release: push/pull sync contract for the Aoide curation store.
